name: 重复模式检测
description: 检测 excessive 模式 repetition characteristic of AI生成的 text.
useCase: Identifying AI text through repetition 分析
mechanism: 分析 micro-模式 frequency 以检测 excessive repetition. AI text generators tend to reuse sentence structures and phrases more than human writers.
source: Krishna et al. (2024) - Paraphrasing Evades Detectors of AI-Generated Text
parameters: 窗口大小: 自适应, Quantization: 8-64 levels, Metrics: 熵, CV, 相关性
strengths:
- Effective for detecting AI生成的 text
- Language-agnostic 统计 approach
- Works with any text length
- Low computational overhead
limitations:
- Less effective on edited or paraphrased AI text
- Domain-specific content may trigger 误报
- Short texts provide less reliable signals
- Performance varies 跨 写作风格s

references.title: Krishna et al. (2024) - Paraphrasing Evades Detectors of AI-Generated Text
Holtzman, A. et al. (2020). The Curious Case of Neural Text Degeneration. ICLR.
Mitchell, E. et al. (2023). DetectGPT: Zero-Shot Machine-Generated Text Detection using Probability Curvature. ICML.
